name: Word-by-Word Handwritten
easing: each word: spring pop {damping:12,stiffness:140,mass:0.7}, one word every 7 frames starting f6
bestFor: Narration punchlines of 3-7 words, one idea ('Real tasks break paper scores').
keyframeTable: rest: 2 centered lines, 96px, one orange word
script: Words appear every 7 frames; each scales up with a small spring and un-rotates from a random ±3° tilt.
Line break happens automatically at 1300 px.
The emphasized word index renders orange.
